verdict.rationale: Letta ships an Agent SDK, an App Server with an OpenAI-compatible API, and a CLI, so API versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents versioned API endpoints, version pinning, or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The 'legacy SSE' MCP transport mention is about transport support, not an API versioning or deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
